pin_project.pin_description: Move Northwind’s storefront from a legacy monolith to a headless React + Azure commerce platform with a new checkout and loyalty integration.
Fixed-price analytics programme: unify POS and inventory data and deliver store performance dashboards to 120 stores.
GDPR-compliant patient portal for appointment booking, lab results and secure messaging.
Monthly retainer: L2/L3 support and small enhancements for the fleet tracking platform.
Roll out Project Infinity to every delivery team: training, data migration and PMO reporting.
Mobile loyalty app with digital receipts, points and personalised offers.
Migrate 12 years of order history into the new platform with reconciliation reports.
ISO 27001 readiness assessment and remediation plan.
